horoscope: You are very much going your own way when it comes to ideas and decisions, dear Aries, and you can be very excited about your personal interests or projects today, feeling on top of things. Today's Moon encourages you to try new things and experiment or diversify. You’re in particularly great shape for resolving recent problems related to communication, learning, or transportation. Generally, with Saturn now retrograde, there is a need to slow down and reflect on your responsibilities and duties. Saturn's retrograde will last until December 10th, and is in your sign. If you feel disconnected from the purpose of the responsibilities brought on by this Saturn transit to your sign, then this retrograde can effectively magnify the heaviness or weight of them, even if they haven’t changed or increased. In other words, your perception of your responsibilities can alter. You're learning to rely on yourself and getting your life into order with Saturn in your sign, and moderation helps now! Returning to a previous project may be particularly rewarding during this cycle. Right now, don’t put pressure on yourself to make decisions or to even have a set-in-stone plan.

You can feel inspired on business and practical levels today, dear Taurus. Creative ideas about how to manage, handle, or increase your resources, personal possessions, or money can be in the offing now. With today's Moon, you’re more likely to invest extra energy into your ambitions and performance. Wonderful energy is with you for resolving a business or money problem or an issue of respect or ownership in a relationship. The desire to put something behind you can lead to a confrontation that works in your favor or a hands-on approach to problem-solving. Saturn has just recently turned retrograde, and until December 10th, it’s best to take it easy, consider your responsibilities, and work step by step toward your goals. It's a natural time for you to review your obligations and reconsider your plans. This week can feel a little heavy in spots as you sense that you’re switching gears, but in time, you will adjust to this shift, and you’re likely to welcome this review period. It’s not an ideal cycle for launching major long-term projects, but revisiting and completing old projects can be rewarding.

The creative side of you is strong today, dear Gemini, and you'll want to take action rather than just imagine what you want to do in the future. Friends, associates, and networks add value to your life in more distinct ways than usual. Hands-on activities fare especially well, and so do ideas and ventures that allow you to socialize, create, and invent. Someone could put in a good word for you or can be an advocate for your work or ideas. Your personality tends to lead, and you get noticed now. While you're cooperative in a group setting, you're also standing out. With today's Moon, you're in the mood for a change. Perhaps it's only about the scenery or the pace for emotional refreshment. You'll thoroughly enjoy learning new things today. Saturn recently turned retrograde, and you're beginning to see the need to review, reflect, and reorganize your work, long-term plans, or social life and happiness goals. A shift in perspective occurs this week, and it’s wise to consider that increases or expansion may lead to stress rather than joy for the time being. Focusing on what you already have going can be more rewarding. This retrograde cycle lasts until December 10th, and it’s best to remind yourself that efforts to build and restructure benefit you in the long run.

There can be a pleasant feeling of camaraderie or cooperation today, dear Cancer. Differences of opinion seem a little easier to take if you approach them from a mental plane rather than an emotional one. You can feel quite passionate about a project or end goal and motivated to improve. Putting your principles to work can be satisfying, or volunteering or supporting others can be rewarding today. You can be in a good position of understanding about a private, personal, or past matter, and you may have the opportunity to release a burden. You might make more sense of your feelings or a situation or get in touch with an attitude or fear that has held you back. It can feel good to be more self-aware. With Saturn recently turning retrograde, you can be feeling a shift in perspective about your long-term goals, responsibilities, career, or life path. There is a real need to simplify your career efforts and reputation since expansion can bring undue stress. It’s a great time to build upon current projects or return to unfinished endeavors.

You can feel inspired by healthy levels of cooperation today, dear Leo, and a spirit of sharing and learning. You tend to take the lead in a group setting, but you're open to entertaining others' ideas today. With decreased focus on the self and more concentration on the team or group, you meet with the most success today. People can see you as a pioneer when it comes to your ideas. This can be a time for a renewed friendship or connection. You're feeling friendly and open now, and this can help you rise above some issues of misunderstanding likely present today. Today's Moon inspires your need for companionship, feedback, or a different perspective. Dilemmas with friends, associates, or long-term goals may resolve, or your path becomes apparent as you come to a better understanding of a situation, leading you to take action. Improvement and motion on are in focus.

The ability to see the bigger design or long-term plans helps you form excellent strategies today, dear Virgo. This is a positive time for work matters, management, cooperation, and relationships with people up the chain of command. You are going your own way when it comes to career or goals, and it works well for you now. Your excitement about your projects is notable now. The Moon spends today in your work and health sector, encouraging you to handle your practical affairs. It's a good time to resolve to deal with a situation that’s frustrated you in recent days and move on. It’s a fine time for releasing tension and taking steps toward healing, improving, and growing. You may want to put more effort into your job, duties, or routines today, and you pay particular attention to health and wellness initiatives.

There can be a nice spirit of cooperation and positivity with you today, dear Libra. Today’s Moon reminds you of the need for light entertainment and fun. You seem to need that extra spark right now, even if it appears to be pulling you off course temporarily. Sharing ideas with others is fruitful. You can be particularly motivated to get out and about or to enjoy shared activities. Debates tend to be entertaining and even enlightening rather than frustrating. You might find it particularly enjoyable to organize around the home or enjoy your personal life today, dear Scorpio. This can be a good time for taking a breather from too much thinking and analyzing. Even so, you can feel passionately about your ideas and projects and can be pleasantly involved in research or a passion project. This can be a solid time for gaining new insight into important people in your life. You're also making time for relaxing, familiar, or quiet activities. You’re more reflective than usual, preferring familiar places and spaces. Certainly, you’re part of a more interactive and connected theme at this time, but a hiatus can be refreshing now. It may be that centering yourself is necessary to share yourself more freely and happily with others. It’s easy to make sense of a tricky situation, allowing you to move on. Taking action is satisfying now, and it’s about growing and improving, particularly in a relationship, with money matters, and family or home affairs. It’s a beautiful day for releasing a burden or for healing a grievance.

There can be a sense of excitement about a person or cause now, dear Sagittarius, or a person in your life inspires you to improve, grow, or reach towards a goal you previously felt was out of reach. Today positions you well to connect, study, and gather information. Your unique ideas come across more clearly, and reaching out can bring interesting people into your life. The day’s energies tend to encourage your desire to branch out. It’s a time for diversifying, pursuing your mental interests, and following your curiosity. You can find yourself in a great position to accept or resolve a relationship matter that may have caused you some recent stress. You’re inclined to want to take action on a matter rather than hold onto it, which can mean talking through a problem with someone and releasing pent-up worries or frustrations. Partnering up can work well right now, particularly when solving problems or working out a game plan.

Your focus today can be on comforting and reinforcing activities, dear Capricorn. You might come up with a creative business or money-making idea. Your work, home life, and domestic affairs benefit from strategic planning and positive actions meant to improve these areas of life. This is a welcome wind of change. At the same time, you crave more comfort and predictability today. It’s a time for slowing down and centering yourself, even though part of you wants to rev up or do something different. You can find yourself in a great position to resolve recent problems related to work, health, routines, or daily affairs. Shared activities and collaboration are especially in favor today, dear Aquarius. Today is more about inspiration and creativity than attention to the details, and you need these kinds of days as much as you need those times of practical intelligence. With today's transits, you’re inclined to be more direct about how you feel today, and you tend to allow your emotions to lead you. Loving feelings are easy to tap. You shine for your creative ideas, insight, or unique viewpoint today.

With today’s transits, you might choose to say no to demanding situations or other extras in your life, dear Pisces. It can be an excellent time to access your intuition and explore your unmet needs, however. There can also be positive progress around the home, with business, or towards the goal of greater security. You may need to release frustration now, and great energy is with you for doing so.
